units: H = scene units per body height; world frame = (p_scene - origin_scene)/H, x screen-right, y up, z toward the camera

arm.hand_target: upper-body space: wrist = wrist_rest + (s*(hx>0 ? 0.95*L*hx : 1.05*L*hx), 1.05*L*hy, 0.80*L*hz), s = -1 screen-left / +1 screen-right, L = 0.57; then kept on its own side (|x| >= 0.07), pushed out of the torso ellipsoid centre (0,0.88,0) radii (0.56,0.56,0.52), reach clamped to 0.995*L from the shoulder (shoulder y + 0.10*shoulder_*). The upper body (shoulders, arms, head) turns with body_yaw/pitch/lean about the waist.
arm.grasp: museGrasp(side): palm centre + palm normal*0.07 + fingers*0.01; frame columns = across the palm, toward the fingertips, out of the palm (character-local)

leg.foot_target: ankle = ankle_rest + root_linear^-1 * (H * foot_{l,r}_{x,y,z}) in character-local space (the params are WORLD-axis offsets in H from where the rest stance, carried by the root transform, would put it); knees bend forward; reach clamped to 0.995*(thigh+shin) from the hip

step.notes: short plush legs: steps of ~0.10-0.13 H (0.23-0.30 scene), lift ~0.05 H; the pelvis can dip via body_bounce (-1..1 = -0.07..+0.07 scene)

sitting.root_y_for_seat: root_y = (seat_height_scene - 0.37)/2.30 (seat top height above the floor, scene units)
sitting.notes: the bottom of the belly (and the thighs' underside when horizontal) rest on the seat; shins hang; on a seat higher than ~0.07 scene the feet dangle (a toy on a chair). The seat should be >= 0.6 scene wide/deep.

hand_map.note: muse.glsl charInit, numbers for code: upper-body wrist = rest_wrist + (s*gain_x*L*hx, gain_y*L*hy, gain_z*L*hz), s = -1 screen-left; gain_x = gain_x_out for hx > 0 else gain_x_in; |x| >= min_x. An EMPTY paw whose palm (~palm_above_wrist over the wrist) would be inside the head is pushed onto the face surface in front (head space, inflated by 0.085) and the arm stretches up to 1.7x to get there.

face.units: head space: origin = the head centre (head_scene at rest), x OUTWARD on the paw's own side (mirrored per paw), y up, z out of the face; scene units. Where a paw's palm goes for a face touch; the shader then rests it on the surface in front of that point.
face.note: the muse's big head (radii 0.70 0.64 0.62) sits in front of short arms (0.57): face targets come from these points + the head pose a gesture sets (app/motion.js museFace), never the old characters' contract numbers. Highest palm reach is head-space y ~0.12 (hand_*_y 1.4), so 'top of the head' = the temple / upper side with the head tilted toward the paw.

nod.note: framed full-body the face is ~90 px tall at 480x270, so the shared 0.11 rad dip moved it ~4 px; 2.4x = 0.26 rad (~13 px), three dips that barely decay. Reflex/listen nods keep their own cycles and amp, scaled the same.

think.note: the thinking gesture's head-only variants (away / up / tilt / hmm) turn the head 0.05-0.11 rad on the seated characters; framed full-body that is 2-4 px at 480x270 (visual QA: near-invisible). 2.2x on the head angles of those variants; the chin pose is not scaled.

stand_note: the muse STANDS by default (root_y 0 = standing on its feet); the 'stand' param is ignored
notes: Analytic from animals/muse.glsl constants (body). Head-heavy plush: the centre of mass is high (1.33 scene = 0.58 H). Root rotation pivots on the com; squash about the base point (0,0,0).
